newsitem.title: USA: Brown Disc seeks more time to report.
newsitem.headline: Brown Disc seeks more time to report.

text.p: Brown Disc Products Co Inc said Friday it will file an extension notice for its annual 10K report to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, due September 28, adding it expects to file before October 15.
The company also said it continues to seek expansion and diversification notwithstanding the recent termination of a proposed merger with Kimbrough Computer Sales Inc.
Brown Disc said it has identified one acquisition candidate, adding it has sufficient capital to sustain its operations as management pursues diversification.

It said the filing extension is required for completion of audited financial statements that reflect numerous transactions during the last fiscal year, involving the restructure and compromise of debt obligations and various capital stock transactions.

Brown Disc said it has made significant progress in improving its balance sheet since new management assumed control in late 1995. But net income was hurt by a sales decline and non-recurring charges for capital stock issuances in raising additional capital and debt restructuring, partially offset by a gain on debt forgiveness.
Brown Disc said it will be launching its Internet software distribution site in the near future to allow its current duplication customers to sell and distribute their software over the Internet.
The company said it is also working on a cable TV software distribution strategy in which it plans to deliver software via a cable download to those customers who have cable modems.

Brown Disc said it is exploring the possibility of obtaining rights to manufacture and produce the new LS120 diskette, a 3.5" floppy diskette developed by Compaq Computer Corp and Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co which stores 120MB of data.

The company said it is working closely with its investment banker on possible acquisition strategies which fit these distribution models and has identified at least one potential acquisition on which the company is currently conducting due diligence. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610
